title: DC Bus — Minor Voltage Ripple Detected
description: DC bus voltage P090 shows increased ripple: peak-to-peak = {val} V (limit 15 V). Mean voltage {val2} V within spec.
probable_cause: Aging DC bus capacitors or increased regenerative energy.
diagnostic_steps: Measure capacitance of DC bus capacitors
Check for excessive regenerative braking events
remedy: Monitor. Plan capacitor inspection at next scheduled maintenance.
required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.
escalation_path: If ELC-WN-001 is not addressed (log event. no immediate action required. review at end of shift.), the fault will escalate in this order: ELC-CR-001, then ELC-MD-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
